# GVC Atlas

Supply-chain exposure, risk, position, gaps and change for 72 economies plus Rest of World and 35 sectors, 2017-2024, computed from the Asian Development Bank Multiregional Input-Output tables. A static site: every answer is read from the JSON files listed below, there is no server.

- [Data contract](data.md): every file, field and formula
- [Metadata](data/meta.json): years, economies (code, name), sectors, in the order all arrays follow

## Files

Economies and sectors are addressed by index, in `meta.json` order. Each economy has 37 rows: sectors c1..c35, then `all` and `mfg`.

- Economy-year, all fields: [data/2024/IND.json](data/2024/IND.json) (`data/{year}/{ECON}.json`)
- All economies, scalar fields: [data/2024/index.json](data/2024/index.json) (`data/{year}/index.json`)
- One economy across years, scalar fields: [data/series/IND.json](data/series/IND.json) (`data/series/{ECON}.json`)

## URLs

`#/{economy}/{sector}/{year}/{view}[/{partner}]`

- economy: code from `meta.json`, e.g. `IND`
- sector: `c1`..`c35`, `all` or `mfg`
- view: `exposure`, `risk`, `position`, `gaps`, `change`
- Example: [#/IND/c14/2024/exposure](./#/IND/c14/2024/exposure)
